subject: jarl-yrsa
q: The rulership was attributed to her brother OLAF in the history books. Nobody has said whether Olaf existed, consented, or knew.
detail:
THREE SHAPES AND THE ARCHIVE IS PICKING NONE OF THEM.

ONE: OLAF WAS REAL AND THE ATTRIBUTION WAS A COVER THEY BOTH AGREED TO, which makes him an ally and the books a deliberate screen.
TWO: OLAF WAS REAL AND THE ATTRIBUTION HAPPENED LATER, by chroniclers who could not write down a woman holding a jarldom, which makes him a bystander and the erasure posthumous.
THREE: OLAF WAS NEVER THERE AT ALL, and the books built a brother because the alternative was unwriteable.

VIRAENA’S PHRASING LEANS TOWARD THE SECOND: THE RULERSHIP WAS ATTRIBUTED TO HER BROTHER OLAF IN THE HISTORY BOOKS, BUT SHE SAW AND WELCOMED US. ATTRIBUTED IN THE BOOKS is about the record rather than about the hall. IT IS STILL A LEAN AND NOT A RULING.

AND THIS ARCHIVE HAS A SPECIFIC REASON TO CARE ABOUT THIS ONE BEYOND CURIOSITY, WHICH IS THAT IT IS THE SAME FAILURE IT KEEPS MAKING AT SMALLER SCALE. A jeweler written as a blacksmith. A bartender handed a wrench. A dancer given her wife’s hammer. A gardener’s lawn billed to a woodworker. IN EVERY CASE THE RECORD ASSIGNED THE DEED TO WHOEVER IT SOUNDED LIKE INSTEAD OF WHOEVER DID IT. A THOUSAND YEARS AGO SOMEBODY DID THAT TO A JARL, and Selene and Viraena are the only two people left alive who were in the room.
